row.notes: Base signal dispatcher: first offers the signal to each behaviour in +0x30..+0x38 (vfunc 0x78, stop if handled), then compares pin hash signal+8 against a table of global hashes (146ca47b4..146ca4848) and calls own vfuncs 0x98/0xa0/0xa8/0xc0/0xc8/0xd0/0xd8/0xe0 with 0/1, sets or clears flag bits at +8 (0x20) and +9 (0x40), reads string/int args to set properties (+0x48, +0x4c on a sub-object), and forwards g_Vm_RaiseCommandPinHash to parent +0x20 vfunc 400. Derived HandleSignal functions fall back to this. Decompile has a merged tail, so details are partial.
